preview.title: Genshin Impact Version 7.1 Special Program Preview
preview.raw_excerpt:
Dear Traveler, it's announcement time!The special program for Genshin Impact's new version will premiere on the official Twitch and YouTube channels on 09/12/2026 at 08:00 AM (UTC-4)!This special program will feature juicy details about new game content and developments in Version 7.1. It will also "drop" some redemption codes and other goodies!
Make sure to follow us, Traveler. We'll see you there!TwitchYouTube
